name: deployment-config-runtime
goal: Runtime dependencies resolve in bundled Node and external preview execution

evidence: PR 15 introduced a deep JSONC ESM import that Node cannot resolve; the managed web preview returns 500 with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for impl/format.
The existing deployment-config boundary test bundles every dependency, hiding external package entry resolution. Extend its matrix to both bundled and external JSONC under Node.

775ea77b reproduces the actual impl/format resolution failure with the installed package found; bundled mode passes and external mode fails under Node. Earlier 3ae3496c had an incorrect NODE_PATH and is setup failure, not defect proof.
